Total length covered by a set of ranges

Source: R/utils.R
covered_length.Rd

Computes the number of positions covered by the union of 1-based, inclusive integer ranges, so overlapping or nested ranges are counted only once. Zero-width ranges (end < start, e.g. from empty elements) and ranges containing NA are ignored.

Usage

covered_length(start, end)

Arguments

start, end

Integer vectors of equal length with range boundaries (1-based, inclusive).

Value

A single integer: the number of covered positions.

Details

Equivalent to sum(IRanges::width(IRanges::reduce(IRanges::IRanges(start, end)))), but without the Bioconductor dependency.

See also

anno_ranges()
